finding.expected: Bind DELTA validation to the exact predecessor already established by correction continuity: parent RUN identity, embedded review identity, reviewed SHA, and finding identity. Do not search TASK-wide by finding id. Reused finding ids in unrelated review decisions must have no effect. Add a focused deterministic regression proving exact predecessor binding when the same finding id appears in another review.
finding.issue: REVIEW-086-001 F1 is fixed: exact local REMEDIATION/REPAIR children of the canonical remote tip now reduce to WAIT while active and RETRY_TRANSPORT when locally terminal, while unrelated or multiple local tips remain fail-closed. However the separate lineage defect previously recorded as REVIEW-086-001 F2 remains unchanged in this candidate. DELTA review validation still finds `prior_review` by scanning all TASK reviews for any finding whose id equals `prior_finding_id`. Finding ids are review-local, so reuse of the same id in another review can make an exact correction lineage appear ambiguous or can bind the wrong predecessor.
